complaint: I made my monthly mortgage payment of $2,100 on time, but the servicer misapplied the funds into escrow instead of principal, and assessed an improper late fee of $120.
admin_notes: Mortgage servicer corrected ledger allocation to principal & interest. Late charge of $120 reversed and credited.

complaint: My bank charged four consecutive overdraft fees of $35 each on the same day due to an internal system batch processing reordering of debit transactions.
admin_notes: Reviewed transaction posting order. Courtesy refund of $140 credited back to customer checking account.

complaint: I applied for a credit limit increase on my card 3 weeks ago. Can you explain the status and documentation required for underwriting review?
admin_notes: Provided underwriting status update and secure portal link for submitting updated proof of income.
